name: doorway
description: Doorway (门口) generator: the full 7-layer human entrance — recess niche, frame ring, lintel/arch band with keystone, door leaves (mirrored-hinge double doors), stoop steps, canopy awning with lanterns, symmetric side lantern posts. Replaces the 'bare vanilla door block' look. Emits explicit minecraft:air cells that carve the opening INTO the wall (dormer-style force carve). Arch openings: stepped half-arch, rise = ceil(width/2), mirrored by construction, apex swaps to keystone material. Frame mode is chosen by material suffix: *_trapdoor = 活板门包框 on the wall face + log side posts, *_stairs = 楼梯描边 (jambs face into opening, upside-down stair lintel), anything else = solid inlaid ring. All direction states derived from origin+params.
when_to_use: Any exterior wall needs a door that reads as an entrance, not a hole with a door block in it. origin = bottom-LEFT cell of the door OPENING as seen from outside, y = the sill layer (the cell the door leaf's lower half occupies); the wall face plane runs through origin and the generator carves recess+1 cells deep from it. facing = the outward direction the door looks to. The host wall must already exist (or be planned) at that plane; wall thickness should be >= recess+1. DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half/hinge/open in the output JSON; change params and re-run (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 民居 1x2 活板门包框、小康 2x2/2x3 双开正门、石造楼梯描边门套、3-5 宽拱形门洞(民居拱门/大厅)、大门洞只留空(door_block=none)的开放式入口

origin.notes: 门洞底左格(从外面看的左侧); y = 门槛层

width.notes: 门洞宽; 中世纪民居 1 (86%), 现代/小康 2 双开; >=3 建议 style=arch

height.notes: 门洞直段净高; arch 总高 = height + ceil(width/2), 中心净高>=3 自动满足

style.notes: rect=直门洞; arch=阶梯半圆拱(拱高=宽/2, 镜像对称, keystone 换料)

frame.notes: 框料, 必须与墙面拉开明度差(浅墙深框: dark_oak/spruce; 深墙浅框: quartz). *_stairs=楼梯描边(facing 脚本推导), *_trapdoor=活板门包框+原木侧柱, 其他=实块镶框

recess.notes: 凹龛进深 = 门扇坐深; 墙厚须 >= recess+1; 0=门扇贴墙面(1 格薄墙用 0)

canopy.notes: 小雨棚: 出挑 1, 宽=门洞+框, 两端檐下各挂 1 灯笼; 材料由 frame 衍生(*_slab; trapdoor 框则关合活板门)

steps.notes: 门前一级台阶(stoop): tread 1, 宽=门洞+框, 放在 origin 下一层(门外地面在 origin-2 层的抬高地基场景最自然)

door_block.notes: 门扇; 宽>=2 自动双开且铰链显式镜像(把手居中); 奇数宽>=3 只放居中扇+两侧整对; none=只留洞

side_decor.notes: 门旁对称灯笼柱(木框->*_fence, 石框->*_wall + lantern), 位在框外一格

keystone.notes: arch 拱顶中央换料(宽>=3 生效, 偶数宽成双); 空串=不换料

pitfalls: 门洞必须切进墙体而不是贴在墙面上 —— 输出里的 minecraft:air 单元就是干这个的(掏洞+凹龛), 禁止删掉; 没有 place_air 能力时先手工挖掉对应墙块再放置
框料不许与墙面同色同料(深框浅墙铁律): 白墙配白框=门口没做任何装饰, 浅色墙用 dark_oak/spruce 系, 深墙反转型用 quartz/白混凝土
arch 拱厚=墙厚, 至少 2 格才不像纸板 —— recess=1 起; 1 格薄墙做拱请 recess=0 并接受薄拱(研究点名反例)
origin 的 y 取门洞底格(门槛层): 抬高地基时台阶默认放在 y-1 层, 平地入口开 steps 会把门口地面换成齐平台阶(无害但没必要)
双开门铰链是脚本按格显式指定的(左扇 hinge=right, 右扇 hinge=left, 把手居中), 手改 hinge 或连放两次同参数 = 铰链不镜像的低级错误
活板门包框模式下 canopy 的两端灯笼占住框上角位(角部活板门省略), 这不是缺块; arch 顶拱心石在墙平面内, 包框在其外侧, 两层叠加是正常观感
拱形禁止徒手改格: profile 由半圆采样镜像生成, 任一手改都会破坏左右对称(头号反例)
example: python patterns/doorway.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"south","width":1,"height":2}' --out door1.json && python patterns/doorway.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,120],"facing":"east","style":"arch","width":3,"height":3,"frame":"minecraft:stone_brick_stairs","door_block":"none"}' --out door2.json
